triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (`fields`) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · GridField, DatePickerField and RecordPickerDialog act on an Enter pressed while an input method is composing, so a Chinese or Japanese user commits or moves mid-word; two byte-identical `isImeKey` copies should become one; same class as #35797; read, not reproduced → p2 (UX rule; every IME user of those widgets) · size S.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T12:34Z · area b1-DB (p2 bug derived from epic #35683).
Area: b1-DB
Session: `session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv` (the b1-DB area thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/issue-35996-ime-enter-fields
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `@object-ui/components` new `lib/ime-key.ts` + its entry export, `dataTableCellSelection.ts`, `renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (import only); `@object-ui/fields` `GridField.tsx`, `widgets/date-picker/DatePickerField.tsx`, `RecordPickerDialog.tsx`, the four widgets that import the predicate, `imeKey.ts` (kept as a one-line re-export of the components predicate, so there is one body), the 35797 test and a new `imeComposition-35996.test.tsx`; changesets (`@object-ui/components` minor for the new export, `@object-ui/fields` patch).
Container & model: `S` code with `M` verification, area sub-agent, `model: opus`, `effort: medium`; the seat runs the declaration-face L2.
Clause-②: yes (widening) (the components entry gains one value export, `isImeKey`; the area measures the built `.d.ts` of both packages)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (area, reproduced in Chromium with a real composition, keyCode 229 and isComposing): holds on all three. A composing Enter in GridField moves focus to the next row (and adds a row on the last one; the arrows are unguarded too); the date box commits a half-typed `2026-0` as invalid; the record picker's page box jumps a page and clears. A plain Enter is correct in each. The two predicate bodies are identical, and nothing keeps them so.
Basis: card #35996.
Scope, the seat's reading: one `if (isImeKey(e)) return;` guard in each of the three handlers (arrows included in GridField); the predicate's one home is the `@object-ui/components` entry (option A: the card names it, the grid copy already lives there, and fields already depends on components); a pin per control with a composing sequence, the Safari 229 Enter after composition, and a plain-Enter control, each ablated.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36054 (#36023 S4) rewrites `data-table.tsx` and `DatePickerField.tsx`, and #36039 (#36023 S5) rewrites `GridField.tsx` and imports `fields/imeKey.ts`. Both are open, so this builds now but pushes after S4 has landed and merges main then; `imeKey.ts` stays as a re-export so S5's import keeps working, and `overlap-check.mjs` runs against #36039 before the push. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #35996`.
